commits.subject: Update terminology from "Response" to "Communication" in FedRAMP Incident Evaluation rules across multiple definitions and statements.
Fix typo in "significant change evaluation" description in FedRAMP consolidated rules.
Update metadata version and last_updated field in FedRAMP consolidated rules.
Update schema URL in FedRAMP consolidated rules for FRC-CSO-PKG definitions
Update schema URLs in FedRAMP consolidated rules to latest version (2026-06-24)
Fix typo in schema URL for FedRAMP Significant Change Notifications
Add schema URL validation test and update documentation
